entities.name: 21st German Bundestag
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: The 21st Bundestag, the federal parliament of Germany, was elected in the 23 February 2025 federal election. It was constituted on the last possible date, 25 March, with the old parliament changing the constitution in between.
